method: Three existing frozen observed corpora ran sequentially through isolated headless production UI with pinned local MiniLM classify/encode and the existing generative-worker fixture. Exact full turn dictionaries compared against both argument-integration01 and checkpoint13; no normalization,retries,process restarts,oracle rewrites or expected-state injection.
limitations: Observed regression evidence,not fresh independent acceptance.
Strict status and whole-row preservation do not independently establish semantic correctness.
All native failures remain in their original reports.
